name.description: Trigger the connector by name. Mutually exclusive with `value`.

value.description: Trigger the connector by value. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

params.description: Optional key/value pairs passed to the connector, accessible via @@paramname in Connector commands.

functionName.description: The name of the script function to execute.

parameter.description: Optional JSON-serializable parameter object passed to the script function.
